english.meaning: to give or take extra lessons in a subject
english.note: Used for private tutoring, as in 補Oral. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: But yeah. My old classmates all really hated them, but still had to keep taking lessons with them.
